thread:
Keisha: opened PR with a focused migration guide and public-facing wording for audit exports + retention. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518 — pinging legal + infra for SOC2 language and rollout caveats.
Omar: skimmed. good work. please avoid 'redaction' in public docs; legal prefers 'pseudonymize' as the term. Also can you add a tiny example showing pseudonymization output schema?
Lina: can we show both a curl and an SDK example? mobile teams asked for Kotlin parity.
Priya: legal note: SOC2 mapping must be explicit. rewrite the control sentence to be prescriptive: 'Audit logs include tenant and actor identifiers strictly for operational troubleshooting. Exports intended for analytics MUST pseudonymize or exclude tenant identifiers per customer-configured export policy.' remove any 'may'.
Sam (docs): updating: swapped 'redact' -> 'pseudonymize', added curl, JS, Python and Kotlin snippets. curl example: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export -d '{"pseudonymize":true, "since":"2024-06-01"}'
``` JS example: ```js
await redwood.audit.export({orgId: 'org-42', pseudonymize: true, retentionDays: 180});
``` Python: ```py
redwood.audit.export(org_id='org-42', pseudonymize=True, retention_days=180)
``` Kotlin: ```kotlin
Redwood.audit().export(orgId = "org-42", pseudonymize = true, retentionDays = 180)
``` JSON pseudonymized sample: `{"actor_id":"pseud_6f3a","event":"user.login","ts":"2024-06-30T12:01:02Z"}`
Keisha: added a short migration blurb for existing customers and a Terraform snippet for the provider. Terraform: ```hcl
resource "redwood_audit_settings" "s" {
  org_id = "org-42"
  export_pseudonymize = true
  default_retention_days = 180
}
``` Also added a one-liner CLI helper for ops: `redwood audit reprocess --org org-42 --since 2023-01-01 --pseudonymize`
infra-bot: Warning: Reprocessing historical exports is IO- and cost-intensive. Recommend scheduled incremental jobs and a canary phase. See ops link: https://internal.redwood/ops/export-guidelines
Omar: infra concern: customers flipping pseudonymize on will expect immediate effect; clarify in docs that historical exports are not changed automatically unless they run reprocess. add a note about data residency / export copies.
Sam (docs): added migration checklist and a short ops-runbook link. Also fixed a broken anchor to the audit API doc.
compliance-bot: Automated check: PR 518 missing SOC2 control mapping for CC7 and CC8. Please add mapping table or mark as N/A.
Priya: I'll drop a minimal mapping snippet tying the export behavior to CC7 evidence items and how to produce auditor samples (time-bounded exports, pseudonymization proof). Keep it brief and link to controls.
legal-bot: Reminder: Public docs should avoid committing to retention durations that vary by contract. Keep examples and mark as 'example only'; highlight that contract overrides prevail.
Lina: added Kotlin snippet parity and a short mobile note. Also suggested adding a sample log redaction policy for customers who want stricter defaults.
Keisha: thanks all. plan: update PR with Priya's mapping, merge after infra ack and legal final sign-off. aiming for EOD merge window and we will include it in next docs release notes.
Sam (docs): pushed the mapping table and wording changes, requested final reviews.
Omar: infra ack in thread. we'll run a 5% canary + 24h soak and watch job depth.
Priya: legal sign-off with one punctuation nit fixed. :white_check_mark:
Sam (docs): merged PR after approvals, tagged release notes and closed branch. Thanks everyone! :tada:
